name: Novobiocin

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States, first in 2009 — for liver harm, blood problems and serious skin reactions

examples.title: Patients Response to Early Switch To Oral:Osteomyelitis Study
examples.why: Not enough patient enrollment and lack of staffing

summary: Novobiocin was pulled from the United States market, beginning in 2009, due to harm to the liver, blood problems, and severe skin reactions [3]. In addition, a small computer model rather than testing on people estimated the drug's risk scores, rating it high for liver problems and low for heart issues [M]. A clinical study examining the drug was also stopped early because it could not enroll enough patients and lacked staffing [5].
